message: Astra: Within Alice's email, what does “Provide updates on your progress weekly” reveal about her relationship with David and Emily? How does expanding the instructions change her voice, rather than merely the amount of information? Which detail deserves closer attention before you continue? Why would further thinking be worth its time compared with trying a revision now, and what unresolved uncertainty about the recipients could make thinking first more valuable? What evidence in the draft would justify either choice, and what next step will you choose and carry out?

perception.quote: Provide updates on your progress weekly
